name: Bioaqua Papaya Cleansing Skin Beauty Cleanser 100gm
description:
Bioaqua Papaya Cleansing Skin Beauty Cleanser – 100g
Origin: Made in Korea

Key Features & Benefits:

Papaya Extract: Gently cleanses and nourishes the skin with natural papaya goodness.

Oil Control & Hydrating: Balances water and oil levels while keeping the skin hydrated.

Deep Cleansing: Effectively cleans pores, removing dirt and impurities for a fresh complexion.

Gentle & Refreshing: Mild formula that refreshes the skin without leaving it greasy.

Smooth & Refined Skin: Helps refine texture, leaving skin soft, smooth, and radiant.

Ideal For: Daily use on all skin types seeking clean, healthy, and revitalized skin.
